name: State of Mexico

plates.name: Current design (2024)
plates.fact: The State of Mexico's current plate is white with a maroon, flower-patterned band, the state name, and the motto '¡El poder de servir!' across the top.

plates.name: Previous design (Del Mazo era, about 2019-2023)
plates.fact: Edomex replates by year of issue, so older sets stay legal until their cohort is called; in 2025 that was plates issued in 2020 or earlier.

about: State of Mexico plates to hunt, from the state's own sources on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.
